settings.repere: Bouton · What about shipping time and tracking?
settings.text: What about shipping time and tracking?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We guarantee delivery in 24/48h for the
settings.text: We guarantee delivery in 24/48h for the UK, 4-7 business days for AU and EU, and 4-9 for CA. For the US and other countries, shipping time may extend up to 6-10 business days. We will send you email notifications about the status of your order, and when the package leaves our warehouse, you will receive an email with tracking information. For more information, see our shipping policy or contact our customer service department via email.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I use FLO™ brush on wet hair?
settings.text: Can I use FLO™ brush on wet hair?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We recommend using FLO™ brush on dry or
settings.text: We recommend using FLO™ brush on dry or slightly damp hair. For optimal safety and performance, it's important to ensure your hands are completely dry before using the device due to the microcurrent technology employed.

settings.repere: Bouton · Does it have any side effects?
settings.text: Does it have any side effects?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · No side effects were found. The treatmen
settings.text: No side effects were found. The treatment is non-invasive and pain-free. Our Red Light therapy brush is CE and ROHS approved and compatible with any type of hair or skin condition. It is safe to use with other treatments and is in line with European and American standards.

settings.repere: Bouton · For whom is FLO™ brush not recommended?
settings.text: For whom is FLO™ brush not recommended?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The use of the scalp brush is not recomm
settings.text:
The use of the scalp brush is not recommended if you belong to one of these categories:

- Pregnant individuals.
- Those with cognitive disorders, sensitivity to touch, or perception problems of any kind.
- Individuals with head injuries, scabbing, cracking, swelling, or severe scalp conditions (e.g. acute forms of dermatitis with significant scabs and other severe forms of eczema or skin problems)
- Patients affected by hypertension, if you suffer from seizures, heart problems, or have a pacemaker.
- If you have acute or malignant tumors, bleeding diseases, hemophilia, or similar medical conditions.
- Individuals with allergies that may be related to comb teeth materials: copper, steel, and electroplating.

Prioritize your well-being.
In case of any other doubts or before beginning a new hair care journey consult your doctor or healthcare provider, especially if you have health concerns.

settings.repere: Bouton · What if it stops working?
settings.text: What if it stops working?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · You’re completely covered up. All BLOOME
settings.text: You’re completely covered up. All BLOOME™ products include a 2 year warranty, which covers replacements and repairs due to malfunctions or factory defects. It does not cover wear, theft or accidental damage.

settings.repere: Bouton · How does the Satisfaction Guarantee work
settings.text: How does the Satisfaction Guarantee work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our 120-Day Satisfaction Guarantee is de
settings.text:
Our 120-Day Satisfaction Guarantee is designed to give you enough time to experience the full benefits of FLO™.

Use the device consistently for 120 days.

If you genuinely feel it hasn’t made a meaningful difference for your scalp or hair condition, you can request a refund by contacting our support team.

Once your request is reviewed and approved, you’ll receive a refund according to our policy. For full details and eligibility requirements, please refer to our Refund Policy.

settings.repere: Titre H3 · FAQ
settings.text: FAQ

settings.repere: Bouton · What can I expect and when?
settings.text: What can I expect and when?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · With consistent daily use, most users fi
settings.text:
With consistent daily use, most users first notice improvements at the scalp level.

Within the first few weeks, the scalp environment typically becomes more balanced, with reduced dryness, flakes, and irritation.

Between 4 and 8 weeks, many users report less visible shedding and stronger-feeling hair, as the scalp becomes healthier and more receptive to treatment.

Changes in hair density, thickness, or regrowth take more time and usually appear gradually between 4 and 6 months, in line with the natural hair growth cycle.

Results also depend on the type of treatment used alongside the FLO™ brush and your specific hair goals; whether you’re targeting scalp health, hair strength, or regrowth.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · *Results may be different from person to
settings.text: *Results may be different from person to person. Some people may take longer than others to see important results in terms of hair thickness and regrowth.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I Use FLO™ Brush without serums?
settings.text: Can I Use FLO™ Brush without serums?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, the FLO™ Brush is effective both wi
settings.text:
Yes, the FLO™ Brush is effective both with and without topical treatments.

Even on its own, FLO™ delivers the benefits of red light therapy, microcurrent stimulation, thermotherapy, and scalp massage, which help:

settings.text: Improve blood circulation

settings.repere: Texte · promote growth and thicker-looking hair
settings.text: promote growth and thicker-looking hair over time

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This means you can use the FLO™brush as
settings.text:
This means you can use the FLO™brush as a standalone scalp treatment, especially if you don’t follow a daily topical routine.

However, using FLO™ together with a serum or topical treatment significantly enhances results.

The device is designed to improve scalp receptivity and absorption, helping active ingredients reach the follicles more effectively.

Without a topical solution, you may miss out on the full potential of the system.

For optimal results, we recommend combining FLO™ with a targeted treatment suited to your needs.

Note: FLO™ can be used without the pod when no serum is applied.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I use it with other serums or hair t
settings.text: Can I use it with other serums or hair treatments?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · You can freely use it with your favorite
settings.text:
You can freely use it with your favorite oils or hair treatments (ex minoxidil), counting on the fact that you will maximize their benefits and results without risk or side effects. To prove that, a 2017 clinical study found that red light with topical ointments like minoxidil or finasteride acts synergistically and is recommended to improve hair regrowth.

Please note that the FLO™ Brush purchased on its own is not covered by our money-back guarantee.

settings.repere: Bouton · Who is FLO™ Brush for?
settings.text: Who is FLO™ Brush for?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our hair growth brush is suitable for an
settings.text:
Our hair growth brush is suitable for any hair type and scalp condition and for anyone looking for:

Shinier, healthier hair: Our red light therapy brush can help nourish and revitalize your hair for a radiant, healthy appearance.

Scalp health: Address common concerns like irritation, dandruff, flaking, dry scalp, and oiliness, promoting a balanced scalp environment for hair growth and thicker hair shafts. The technologies of our scalp brush are safe to use and designed to heal the skin soothing itchy scalp and conditions like dermatitis and similar. *If you suffer from severe scalp conditions. please contact your doctor first.

Fighting hair loss: Our hair growth stimulator is suitable for anyone struggling with hair loss and thinning hair, whether due to aging, stress, or hereditary conditions. It stimulates and strengthens hair follicles, boosts nutrient delivery, and creates the perfect environment for hair growth. It has been shown that red light, microcurrents, and even scalp massage can be a valuable support for those struggling with androgenetic alopecia (AGA), helping to slow down hair loss and promote hair growth.

settings.repere: Bouton · Why does It work?
settings.text: Why does It work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · FLO™ works by targeting the key scalp co
settings.text:
FLO™ works by targeting the key scalp conditions that influence hair health and growth.

Red light therapy has been widely studied for its ability to support cellular activity and improve blood circulation in the scalp, helping create an environment where hair follicles can function more efficiently.

Microcurrent stimulation helps reduce scalp tension and support overall scalp health, while thermotherapy and vibrating massage improve blood flow, skin permeability, and relaxation.

This matters because a tense, poorly perfused scalp can limit hair growth, even when effective treatments are applied.

By improving circulation, stimulating the follicles, and enhancing scalp receptivity, FLO™ helps create the ideal conditions for healthier, stronger hair over time.

When used together with topical treatments, these effects are amplified, as the scalp becomes more receptive and better able to absorb active ingredients.

settings.repere: Bouton · How to use it ?
settings.text: How to use it ?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Fill the pod with your chosen serum or t
settings.text:
Fill the pod with your chosen serum or topical treatment, turn on the device, gently massage your scalp in the way you prefer, and there you go!
Make sure you touch the scalp with the brush, slowly following the shape of the head, focusing more on the areas of the scalp you want to revitalize, if there are any. The technologies work through the little teeth (besides red light), and as long as they touch the scalp, the device will work wonders, revitalizing the skin and hair follicles. After 5 minutes, the device turns off automatically.

settings.repere: Titre H3 · I want to know more
settings.text: I want to know more

settings.repere: Bouton · Does Red Light Therapy work?
settings.text: Does Red Light Therapy work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · In 1903 N.Finsen won a Nobel using Red L
settings.text: In 1903 N.Finsen won a Nobel using Red Light (LLLT) to treat cutaneous tuberculosis and other skin conditions. In the ‘80s NASA used Red Light to grow plants in space. Countless studies support Red Light Therapy. In fact, in 2018, 22 studies comparing LLLT to other common drug treatments such as Minoxidil were examined. This meta-analysis concluded that red light therapy was a superior treatment. Most importantly, while many of the drugs had negative side effects, red light therapy was found to have none.

settings.repere: Bouton · Does Microcurrent work?
settings.text: Does Microcurrent work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Its anti-inflammatory effect helps norma
settings.text: Its anti-inflammatory effect helps normalize the functioning of sebaceous glands to moisturize the scalp and kill bacteria. More regulated sebum production makes the dry scalp less dry and the oily scalp less oily. In 2021, a study revealed that microcurrent stimulates cell reproduction and triggers regrowth in resting follicles.

settings.repere: Bouton · Does Scalp Massage help hair growth?
settings.text: Does Scalp Massage help hair growth?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Scalp massage loosens muscle tension and
settings.text: Scalp massage loosens muscle tension and restores proper blood circulation which are key factors in hair loss. It seems that even the greatest emperor in history was already aware of it. It is said that Julius Caesar used to have his head massaged to combat baldness.

settings.repere: Bouton · What does Thermo Therapy do?
settings.text: What does Thermo Therapy do?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It’s what makes the other 3 technologies
settings.text: It’s what makes the other 3 technologies even more effective. Heat allows the hair cuticles to open, allowing the treatment to penetrate deeply, nourishing and moisturizing to promote much faster hair repair and growth.

settings.repere: Bouton · How long does it take for hair to grow b
settings.text: How long does it take for hair to grow back?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Hair grows at an average rate of about 1
settings.text:
Hair grows at an average rate of about 1 to 1.5 centimeters per month. However, this varies depending on factors like age, genetics, and overall health. It's important to note that once a hair follicle is dead, it cannot produce new hair. That’s why acting fast with tools like the FLO™ red light therapy brush is essential to help support active follicles, accelerating the growth cycle and promoting faster, healthier growth.

With consistent use, FLO™ users often notice new hair growth in as little as 3 months, while for more noticeable improvements, it can take up to 6 months of consistent use.
